name: bookinator
description: Bookinator: think of a novel and Folio, an enchanted book, names it with a local Bayesian engine. Remember the story, forget the title.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:engine && npm test && npm run test:db && npm run test:py && npm run test:research && npm run validate && npm run validate:cmu && vite build
scripts.catalog:research: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/merge_research.py && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/motif_labels.py && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/build_cmu_catalog.py --limit 500 --gate none && tsx scripts/gate_catalog.ts
scripts.test:research: node scripts/py.mjs -m unittest discover -s research/chatgpt_source/scripts -p "test_*.py" && node scripts/py.mjs -m unittest discover -s research/chatgpt_source/core_tools -p "test_*.py" && node research/chatgpt_source/five_book_demo/test-engine.cjs
